governing_objective: Evaluate, under a frozen retrospective prequential protocol, whether annual calendar structure improves one-month-ahead forecasts of physical purchase volume or nominal unit price in one exact Finnish industrial-roundwood jurisdiction, and freeze the next genuinely prospective monthly target without pooling jurisdictions.

source.table: Volumes and prices in industrial roundwood trade by Information, Month, Price region, Type of sale and Roundwood assortment

jurisdiction.authority_unit: country x price region x sale type x product x target x month x vintage class

dimension_codes.M: all 79 frozen month codes in chronological order

sequence.rule: each observed month predicts exactly the immediately following calendar month

model_family.response: one-month innovation in the target-specific transformed level
model_family.M1: M0 plus annual Fourier sine/cosine pairs at harmonics k=1 and k=2
model_family.M2: M1 plus eleven exact zero-sum calendar-month contrasts with shrinkage

prequential_weights.update_statistic: post-outcome component Student-t log predictive density
prequential_weights.2020_bootstrap: M1 and M2 emit the frozen M0 predictive distribution while their hidden parameter states learn; identical scores preserve equal weights
prequential_weights.preopened_2026_07: parameter states update for the future 2026-08 freeze, but model-weight evidence and score aggregates do not update

support_and_abstention_gates.missing_value: NOT_ESTIMABLE_INCOMPLETE_PANEL with no fit, forecast, posterior or Z_post
support_and_abstention_gates.nonempty_source_status: NOT_ESTIMABLE_UNINTERPRETED_SOURCE_STATUS with no fit, forecast, posterior or Z_post

recovery_and_immutability.capture_transport_or_validation_failure: preserve staging and stop; no second POST without a new frozen amendment
recovery_and_immutability.local_runner_failure: preserve staging and error; code change requires a new hash-linked amendment before scientific execution

required_artifacts: immutable bounded capture with query, response, headers and manifest
result with target-local rows and diagnostic summaries
prohibitions: no historical acquisition before this preregistration and its software addendum are frozen and publicly pushed
no second remote data POST under this version
no fitting or selection after viewing historical values outside the frozen runner
no reconstructed historical freeze described as a first-release prospective forecast
no pooling with Argentina, Eurostat, RMK, AEAT, Puertos, TED or any other jurisdiction
no winner inferred from year, phase, target or cross-source aggregation
no reset of posterior, Z_post or model weights at a year boundary
no use of raw outcomes to update a future prior except through frozen adjudication and Z_post
no automatic promotion to BIND, production or commercial readiness
